name: Hintertuxer Gletscher
kurzbeschreibung: The only year-round accessible glacier ski area in Austria, reaching up to **3,250 m** – featuring a **Natureis-Palast**, **Gletscherspalten**, and snow certainty **365 days a year**.
beschreibung: The **Hintertuxer Gletscher** in the **Tuxertal** (part of the **Zillertal**) is the only ski resort in Austria with **365 days of skiing per year**. The glacier lift takes visitors up to an altitude of **3,250 meters**. A true highlight is the **Nature Ice Palace**—an impressive ice cave featuring frozen lakes, ice crystals, and light-filled glacier crevasses, accessible only on guided tours. The **Gletscherlehrpfad** (Glacier Educational Trail) provides insights into glacier formation and the impacts of climate change. In summer, the **Tuxer Fernerhaus Round Trail** offers breathtaking views of the surrounding **Dreitausender** (3,000-meter peaks).
